inlines.v: PA'GOD PAGO'DA, noun 1. A temple in the East Indies in which idols are worshiped. 2. An idol; an image of some supposed deity. PAGO'DA, noun A gold or silver coin current in Hindoostan, of different values in different parts of India, from $1.75 cts. to $2, or from 8 to 9s.sterling.
